8.31.1.1. iLock_Geography.predicate_library.protection.FlankProtectionObject.__init__¶

FlankProtectionObject.__init__(signalUserTypes, switchTypes, skipDiverging=False, skipStraight=False, skipIndexFunc=None, argOrder=None, warning=True)¶

Constructor.

Parameters:
  • signalUserTypes (Iterable(string)) – Types of signals that can provide flank protection.
  • switchTypes (Iterable(string)) – Types of switches that can provide flank protection.
  • skipDiverging (bool) – Used for switches. If True, switch with its bent leg as the protection position is not considered. Default is False.
  • skipStraight (bool) – Used for switches. If True, switch with its straight leg as the protection position is not considered. Default is False.
  • skipIndexFunc (callable) – Used for switches. A function that returns a leg index. Switch with its protection leg index equal to the index returned by the function is not considered as a flank protection.
  • argOrder (vtuple(int)?) – See GeoPredicate.
  • warning (bool) – If True, issue an warning is there is no flank protection for a path.
